prompt:
Make `addItem` reject invalid items by throwing an Error, and store valid ones.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: `addItem` now checks each item against the rules in docs/DATA.md and throws an Error if it breaks one. The rules: the name must not be empty, `qty` must be a whole number of 0 or more, the unit must be a single word or empty, tags must be strings, and `expires` must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date if given. Valid items are stored with the name trimmed and lowercased, and the tags lowercased, de-duplicated and sorted. A new id is never one that was used before, even after a removal; previously it could be reused. Any `id` the caller passes is ignored. `npm test` and `npm run lint` pass, and a manual check confirmed each kind of bad input is rejected. I didn't add new tests, because the rules say not to edit `tests/` unless asked. I added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

check.why: rejects bad items, stores good ones by the data rules
